records.sql: SELECT MAX("f"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS "highest_ages_5_17_free_meal_eligibility_rate" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cds WHERE "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".numtsttakr > 0 AND "s".numge1500::NUMERIC / "s".numtsttakr > 0.3 AND "f"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "District Type" = 'Unified School District')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "District Type" = 'Elementary School District'), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "frpm" WHERE "County Name" = 'Orange' AND "District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District') LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".mailstreet, "s".school FROM "satscores" AS "t" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "t".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "t".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "t".avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT "School Name", "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM "frpm" WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" = '9' LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", "f"."District Code" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".admfname1 = 'Alusine' OR "s".admfname2 = 'Alusine' OR "s".admfname3 = 'Alusine' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "schools".admemail1 FROM "schools" WHERE "schools".city ILIKE 'San Bernardino' AND "schools".county ILIKE 'San Bernardino' AND "schools".doctype = 'Unified School District' AND "schools".eilname = 'Intermediate/Middle/Junior High' AND "schools".opendate >= DATE '2009-01-01' AND "schools".opendate < DATE '2011-01-01' AND "schools".admemail1 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".ncesschool FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "s".cdscode IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270') AND "s".ncesschool IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = (SELECT MAX("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM "frpm" WHERE cdscode IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_sat_test_takers_per_school" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sch" ON "sch".cdscode = "f".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "sch".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "f"."Charter School Number" = '0756' AND "sch".mailcity ILIKE 'San Diego' LIMIT 501

SELECT "sc".school, "sc".gsserved AS "grade_span_served" FROM "schools" AS "sc" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "sc".cdscode WHERE "sc".statustype = 'Active' AND "sc".ncesdist = '0613360' AND "sc".eilname = 'High School' AND "sc".gsserved IS NOT NULL AND "sc".gsserved <> '' AND "sc".gsserved LIKE '%12%' AND ("sat".cds IS NULL OR "sat".numtsttakr = 0) ORDER BY "sc".gsserved ASC, "sc".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".sname, ("sc".mailstreet || ', ' || "sc".mailcity || ', ' || "sc".mailstate || ' ' || "sc".mailzip) AS "mailing_address" FROM "satscores" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cds INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "sc".cdscode = "s".cds WHERE "s".rtype = 'S' AND "f"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s".avgscrread = (SELECT MAX("s2".avgscrread) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f2" ON "f2".cdscode = "s2".cds WHERE "s2".rtype = 'S' AND "f2"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s2".avgscrread IS NOT NULL) AND "sc".mailstreet IS NOT NULL AND "sc".mailcity IS NOT NULL AND "sc".mailstate IS NOT NULL AND "sc".mailzip IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".city FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f".cdscode = '01611920113902' AND "f"."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "f"."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND "f"."Low Grade" = '9' AND "f"."High Grade" = '12' AND "s".eilcode = 'HS' LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."School Name", "s".city FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f"."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2' AND "f"."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "f"."Low Grade"::INTEGER > 9 AND "s".eilcode = 'HS' ORDER BY "f"."School Name" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".sname, "sc".phone FROM "satscores" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "s".cds = "sc".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'Statewide Benefit Charter' AND "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "s".numge1500 IS NOT NULL AND "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".numge1500 = (SELECT MAX("s2".numge1500) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f2" ON "s2".cds = "f2".cdscode WHERE "f2"."District Type" = 'Statewide Benefit Charter' AND "f2"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "s2".numge1500 IS NOT NULL AND "s2".rtype = 'S') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".avgscrmath, "s".numtsttakr FROM "satscores" AS "s" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "sc".cdscode = "s".cds WHERE "sc".cdscode = '01611190130609' AND "s".rtype = 'S' AND "sc".charter = 1 AND "sc".fundingtype = 'Directly funded' AND "sc".eilname = 'Elementary-High Combination' LIMIT 501

WITH "target" AS (SELECT numtsttakr FROM "satscores" WHERE cds = '7618040730051') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "satscores" AS "s" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "sc".cdscode = "s".cds CROSS JOIN "target" AS "t" WHERE "s".rtype = 'S' AND "sc".county = 'Contra Costa' AND "s".numtsttakr > "t".numtsttakr LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "satscores" AS "sat" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sch" ON "sat".cds = "sch".cdscode INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "sch".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "sch".mailcity ILIKE 'San Francisco' AND "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND "sat".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND "sat".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL AND "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite >= 1500 AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'Adult' THEN NULL ELSE "f"."Low Grade"::INTEGER + 1 END) = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'Adult' THEN NULL ELSE "f"."Low Grade"::INTEGER + 1 END) = 1 THEN 'K' ELSE (MIN(CASE WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1 WHEN "f"."Low Grade" = 'Adult' THEN NULL ELSE "f"."Low Grade"::INTEGER + 1 END) - 1)::TEXT END AS "Lowest Grade Level" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".ncesdist = '0632640' LIMIT 501

WITH "district_rows" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "f"."County Name" AS "county_name", "f"."District Name" AS "district_name", substring("f".cdscode, 1, 7) AS "district_code" FROM "frpm" AS "f" WHERE "f"."County Name" IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')), "administrator_mentions" AS (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".admfname1 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".admfname1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".admfname2 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".admfname2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".admfname3 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".admfname3 IS NOT NULL), "name_school_totals" AS (SELECT "am".first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "am".cdscode) AS "school_count" FROM "administrator_mentions" AS "am" INNER JOIN "district_rows" AS "dr" ON substring("am".cdscode, 1, 7) = "dr".district_code GROUP BY "am".first_name), "top_names" AS (SELECT first_name FROM "name_school_totals" ORDER BY school_count DESC, first_name ASC LIMIT 2), "district_counts" AS (SELECT "dr".county_name, "dr".district_name, "tn".first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "am".cdscode) AS "school_count" FROM "district_rows" AS "dr" CROSS JOIN "top_names" AS "tn" LEFT JOIN "administrator_mentions" AS "am" ON substring("am".cdscode, 1, 7) = "dr".district_code AND "am".first_name = "tn".first_name GROUP BY "dr".county_name, "dr".district_name, "tn".first_name) SELECT district_name, first_name, school_count FROM "district_counts" ORDER BY county_name ASC, district_name ASC, first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("f"."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_eligible" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".soctype = 'Youth Authority Facilities' LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".school, "s".eilname FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".cdscode = '01612590136051' LIMIT 501

SELECT "sch".school, "sch".admemail1 FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sch" ON "sch".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s".rtype = 'S' AND "s".numge1500 = (SELECT MAX("s2".numge1500) FROM "frpm" AS "f2" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "s2" ON "s2".cds = "f2".cdscode WHERE "f2"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "s2".rtype = 'S') LIMIT 501

SELECT "School Type", "s".school, "s".latitude FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".latitude IS NOT NULL AND "s".state = 'CA' AND "s".statustype IN ('Active', 'Closed') AND ("f"."School Type" ILIKE '%middle%' OR "s".eilname = 'Intermediate/Middle/Junior High' OR "s".school ILIKE '%middle%' OR "s".school ILIKE '%junior high%') AND "s".latitude = (SELECT MAX("x".latitude) FROM "schools" AS "x" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "y" ON "y".cdscode = "x".cdscode WHERE "x".latitude IS NOT NULL AND "x".state = 'CA' AND "x".statustype IN ('Active', 'Closed') AND ("y"."School Type" ILIKE '%middle%' OR "x".eilname = 'Intermediate/Middle/Junior High' OR "x".school ILIKE '%middle%' OR "x".school ILIKE '%junior high%')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_sat_test_takers_per_school" FROM "schools" AS "sch" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "sch".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "sch".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "sch".county = 'Los Angeles' AND "sch".opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01' AND "sch".opendate < DATE '2008-01-01' AND "f"."District Type" <> 'Non-School Locations' LIMIT 501

SELECT "frpm"."Charter Funding Type", COUNT(*) AS "charter_school_count", SUM("frpm"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", ROUND(AVG("frpm"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_frpm_eligible_percentage", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "satscores".avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND "satscores".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND "satscores".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL THEN "satscores".avgscrread + "satscores".avgscrmath + "satscores".avgscrwrite END)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_combined_sat_score" FROM "frpm" INNER JOIN "schools" ON "frpm".cdscode = "schools".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" ON "frpm".cdscode = "satscores".cds AND "satscores".rtype = 'S' WHERE "frpm"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "frpm"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') AND "frpm"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "schools".statustype = 'Active' GROUP BY "frpm"."Charter Funding Type" LIMIT 501

WITH "candidates" AS (SELECT "f"."School Name" AS "school_name", "f"."Low Grade" AS "low_grade", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment", COALESCE("s".numtsttakr, 0) AS "sat_test_takers", CASE "f"."Low Grade" WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1 ELSE CAST("f"."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1 END AS "grade_order" FROM "frpm" AS "f" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."District Type" = 'State Special Schools') SELECT school_name, low_grade, enrollment, sat_test_takers FROM "candidates" ORDER BY grade_order DESC, enrollment DESC NULLS LAST, school_name ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "eligible_schools" AS (SELECT "f".cdscode FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 AND "s".school IS NOT NULL AND "s".school <> '' AND "s".edopscode NOT IN ('COMM', 'COMMDAY', 'CON', 'HOMHOS', 'JUV', 'ROP', 'SPEC', 'SPECON', 'SSS', 'YTH') AND "f"."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "f"."High Grade"::INTEGER BETWEEN 1 AND 8), "site_participation" AS (SELECT "e".cdscode, COALESCE(MAX("sa".numtsttakr), 0) AS "takers" FROM "eligible_schools" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sa" ON "sa".cds = "e".cdscode AND "sa".rtype = 'S' GROUP BY "e".cdscode) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "site_participation" WHERE takers = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."Charter Funding Type", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active') AS "currently_operating", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", SUM("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS "total_frpm_eligible_k12_students" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)' AND "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "f"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY "f"."Charter Funding Type" ORDER BY CASE "f"."Charter Funding Type" WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1 WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school AS "school", "s".district AS "district", "s".county AS "county", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "average_sat_writing_score" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "s".cdscode = "sat".cds WHERE "s".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL AND "sat".avgscrwrite = (SELECT MAX("sat2".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat2" ON "s2".cdscode = "sat2".cds WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sat2".rtype = 'S' AND "sat2".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL AND "sat2".avgscrwrite < (SELECT MAX("sat3".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s3" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat3" ON "s3".cdscode = "sat3".cds WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sat3".rtype = 'S' AND "sat3".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY "s".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "schools" AS "sc" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "sc".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "sc".statustype = 'Active' AND "sc".eilname = 'High School' AND COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0) = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "number_of_schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1) AS "charter_schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0) AS "non_charter_schools" FROM "frpm" AS "f" WHERE "f"."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 12 AS "average_schools_opened_per_month" FROM "schools" WHERE county = 'San Diego' AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' AND doc IN ('31', '34', '42') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "sch".virtual IN ('F', 'P')) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "satscores" AS "sat" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sch" ON "sat".cds = "sch".cdscode WHERE "sat".avgscrmath > 400 LIMIT 501

SELECT "frpm"."School Name", "frpm"."County Name", "frpm"."District Name", "schools".city, "frpm"."Enrollment (K-12)", "frpm"."FRPM Count (K-12)", "frpm"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", "satscores".numtsttakr, "satscores".avgscrread, "satscores".avgscrmath, "satscores".avgscrwrite, "satscores".numge1500 FROM "frpm" INNER JOIN "schools" ON "frpm".cdscode = "schools".cdscode INNER JOIN "satscores" ON "frpm".cdscode = "satscores".cds WHERE "frpm".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "f".cdscode, "f"."School Name" AS "school_name", "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0) AS "free_meal_rate", CASE WHEN "s".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "s".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter_status", "s".gsserved AS "grades_served" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'High School District' AND "s".gsserved IS NOT NULL AND "s".gsserved ~ '(^|[^0-9])12([^0-9]|$)' AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), "scored" AS (SELECT "e".school_name, "e".free_meal_rate, "e".charter_status, "e".grades_served, CASE WHEN "sat".cds IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "sat_performance_level" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "e".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S') SELECT school_name, to_char(free_meal_rate, 'FM0.0000') AS "free_meal_rate", charter_status, grades_served, sat_performance_level FROM "scored" WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school AS "name", "s".phone, "s".website, "sat".avgscrread AS "average_sat_reading", "sat".avgscrmath AS "average_sat_math", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "average_sat_writing", ("s".charter = 1) AS "is_charter_school", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "k12_enrollment", ROUND("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percent_eligible_frpm", (SELECT MAX("sa".avgscrmath) FROM "schools" AS "sch" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sa" ON "sa".cds = "sch".cdscode AND "sa".rtype = 'S' WHERE "sch".statustype = 'Active' AND "sa".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "sa".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL) AS "highest_average_sat_math", (SELECT MAX("sa".avgscrmath) FROM "schools" AS "sch" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sa" ON "sa".cds = "sch".cdscode AND "sa".rtype = 'S' WHERE "sch".statustype = 'Active' AND "sa".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "sa".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL) - "sat".avgscrmath AS "points_below_highest" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

WITH "virtual_schools" AS (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".county, "s".school, "ss".avgscrread FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "ss".cds = "s".cdscode AND "ss".rtype = 'S' WHERE "s".virtual = 'F'), "county_counts" AS (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "virtual_school_count" FROM "virtual_schools" GROUP BY county), "ranked_counties" AS (SELECT county, virtual_school_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC) AS "county_rank" FROM "county_counts"), "best_reading" AS (SELECT county, school, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avgscrread DESC) AS "reading_rank" FROM "virtual_schools" WHERE avgscrread IS NOT NULL) SELECT "rc".county, "rc".virtual_school_count, COALESCE("br".school, 'None') AS "school" FROM "ranked_counties" AS "rc" LEFT JOIN "best_reading" AS "br" ON "br".county = "rc".county AND "br".reading_rank = 1 WHERE "rc".county_rank <= 5 ORDER BY "rc".virtual_school_count DESC, "rc".county ASC, school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "exclusive_virtual_schools" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' AND county IN ('Santa Barbara', (SELECT county FROM "schools" WHERE cdscode = '01100170109835')) GROUP BY county ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, county ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."School Name", "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" FROM "frpm" AS "f" WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100 AND COALESCE("f"."Charter School (Y/N)", 0) = 0 ORDER BY "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT "s".school, "s".street FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".school IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" - "f"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30 AND CASE WHEN "f"."High Grade" = 'K' THEN 0 WHEN "f"."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("f"."High Grade" AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END <= 8 LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."School Name", "s".street FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" - "f"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30 AND "f"."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("f"."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9 ORDER BY "f".cdscode ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "district" AS "d" ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC LIMIT 5), "district_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".district_id), "active_loans" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("l".amount) AS "total_active_loan" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "a".district_id), "averages" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, "td".district_name, COALESCE("al".total_active_loan, 0)::NUMERIC / "da".account_count AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" INNER JOIN "district_accounts" AS "da" ON "da".district_id = "td".district_id LEFT JOIN "active_loans" AS "al" ON "al".district_id = "td".district_id) SELECT district_name, ROUND(average_active_loan_per_account) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "averages" WHERE average_active_loan_per_account = (SELECT MAX(average_active_loan_per_account) FROM "averages") ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "l".amount FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE >= DATE '1995-12-31'), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY region), "ranked" AS (SELECT region, total_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "totals") SELECT region, total_amount FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY region ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("district_avg".avg_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_districts" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC) AS "avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "served" ON "served".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' GROUP BY "d".district_id) AS "district_avg" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "region" ON "region".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' AND "region".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id WHERE "account_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id)) AS "eligible_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "eligible_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "eligible_accounts" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "eligible_accounts".account_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", "a".district_id AS "branch_district_id", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".district_id), "account_details" AS (SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".branch_district_id, "b".total_borrowed, "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "borrowing_accounts" AS "b" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "b".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id), "counterparty_counts" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "outside_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "d".account_id, "d".opening_date, "d".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cc".outside_counterparties, 0) AS "outside_counterparties", "hd".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "hd".a4::BIGINT AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "hd".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "account_details" AS "d" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "d".branch_district_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "d".home_district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparty_counts" AS "cc" ON "cc".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' ORDER BY "hd".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT "account_id", AVG("balance") AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY "account_id"), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "cl"."gender", "d"."a2" AS "district_name", "d"."a4"::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d"."a11" AS "salary", "d"."a13" AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."disp_id" = "c"."disp_id" AND "dp"."type" = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl"."client_id" = "dp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "account" AS "ac" ON "ac"."account_id" = "dp"."account_id" INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa"."account_id" = "ac"."account_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "ac"."district_id" WHERE "c"."type" = 'gold' AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000 AND "d"."a4"::BIGINT > 100000), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, MAX(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM "eligible_districts"), "summaries" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", AVG(salary) AS "avg_salary", AVG(urban_ratio) AS "avg_urban_ratio" FROM "eligible_districts" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'Women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "r".district_name, "r".inhabitants, "s".avg_salary::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS "average_salary", "s".avg_urban_ratio::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS "average_urban_inhabitant_ratio" FROM "summaries" AS "s" INNER JOIN "ranked" AS "r" ON "r".gender = "s".gender AND "r".inhabitants = "r".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC, "r".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "own" ON "own".account_id = "a".account_id AND "own".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "own".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000), "totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "e" ON "e".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT totals.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "totals") SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payments, total_amount_paid FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank = 1 ORDER BY bank ASC, account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t"."k_symbol" = 'SIPO' THEN "t"."amount" ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t"."amount"), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t"."account_id" = "a"."account_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a"."district_id" = "d"."district_id" WHERE "d"."a2" = 'Pisek' AND "t"."type" = 'VYDAJ' AND "t"."k_symbol" IS NOT NULL AND "t"."k_symbol" <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualified_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "rd" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a12 AS "unemployment", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualified_districts" AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id), "av" AS (SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_unemployment" FROM "rd" GROUP BY region), "rn" AS (SELECT region, district_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC) AS "n" FROM "rd") SELECT "av".region, "av".avg_salary, "av".avg_unemployment, "rn".district_name FROM "av" INNER JOIN "rn" ON "rn".region = "av".region AND "rn".n = 1 ORDER BY "av".region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "district_crimes" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a11 AS "inhabitants", COUNT("t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01') AS "crime_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a11), "central_ranked" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, inhabitants, crime_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, lower(translate(district_name, 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ', 'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ')) ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district_crimes" WHERE region = 'central Bohemia'), "summaries" AS (SELECT AVG(crime_count) FILTER (WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "central_ranked" WHERE rn <= 3)) AS "top3_avg", AVG(crime_count) AS "overall_avg" FROM "district_crimes") SELECT "r".district_name, "r".crime_count, ROUND("s".top3_avg::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_crime_count_top_three", ROUND("s".overall_avg::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_crime_count_all_districts", ROUND(("s".top3_avg - "s".overall_avg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "difference" FROM "central_ranked" AS "r" CROSS JOIN "summaries" AS "s" WHERE "r".rn <= 3 ORDER BY "r".rn ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca".type, "cl".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id), "district_markets" AS (SELECT "cd".type, "d".a2, "d".a11 AS "inhabitants" FROM "card_districts" AS "cd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cd".district_id) SELECT type, a2 AS "district", inhabitants FROM (SELECT type, a2, inhabitants, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY type ORDER BY inhabitants ASC) AS "market_rank" FROM "district_markets") AS "ranked" WHERE market_rank = 1 ORDER BY type ASC, a2 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "target_region") AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "latest_tx" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened_accounts" AS "oa" ON "oa".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "oa".district_name, "oa".account_id, "lt".balance FROM "opened_accounts" AS "oa" LEFT JOIN "latest_tx" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "oa".account_id), "district_stats" AS (SELECT district_name, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", ROUND(AVG(balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_end_1996_balance" FROM "account_balances" GROUP BY district_name), "region_stats" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "region_avg_end_1996_balance" FROM "account_balances"), "highest_district" AS (SELECT district_name AS "highest_avg_balance_district" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY avg_end_1996_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "ds".district_name, "ds".accounts_opened, "ds".avg_end_1996_balance, "rs".region_avg_end_1996_balance, "hd".highest_avg_balance_district FROM "district_stats" AS "ds" CROSS JOIN "region_stats" AS "rs" CROSS JOIN "highest_district" AS "hd" ORDER BY "ds".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "d".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "loan_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "top_loans"), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "loan_districts" AS "ld" ON "ld".district_id = "d".district_id) SELECT district_id AS "most_populous_district_id", inhabitants AS "inhabitants", ROUND((SELECT AVG(average_salary::NUMERIC) FROM "district_stats"), 2) AS "average_salary_across_districts" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "da" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "a".account_id FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" USING (district_id) WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000), "wt" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "da" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" USING (account_id) WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "da".district_id), "ot" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, COALESCE(SUM("o".amount), 0)::NUMERIC AS "order_total" FROM "da" LEFT JOIN "order" AS "o" USING (account_id) GROUP BY "da".district_id), "ac" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "da" GROUP BY district_id), "x" AS (SELECT "wt".district_id, "wt".total_withdrawn, "p".population, "wt".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "p".population AS "percap", "ot".order_total / "ac".n AS "avgorder" FROM "wt" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id, population FROM "da") AS "p" USING (district_id) INNER JOIN "ot" USING (district_id) INNER JOIN "ac" USING (district_id)) SELECT "da".district_name, "da".region, "x".population, "x".total_withdrawn, ROUND("x".percap, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "x".percap DESC) AS "rank", ROUND("x".avgorder, 2) AS "avg_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "x" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id, district_name, region FROM "da") AS "da" USING (district_id) ORDER BY rank ASC, "da".district_name ASC LIMIT 46 OFFSET 30

WITH "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "c".client_id) AS "regional_client_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "district_ranked" AS (SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::NUMERIC DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE(a2) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::NUMERIC DESC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE(a11) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::NUMERIC DESC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district") SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened_date", "a".frequency, "ad".a2 AS "district_name", "ad".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "ad".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "ad".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tt".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tt".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tt".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tt".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tt".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rs".regional_client_count AS "regional_client_count", "dr".most_populous_district, "dr".most_populous_inhabitants, "dr".population_rank FROM "disp" AS "access_disp" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "access_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = 3541 INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "region_stats" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "ad".a3 INNER JOIN "district_ranked" AS "dr" ON "dr".district_id = "ad".district_id WHERE "access_disp".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("tt".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "district_year" AS (SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "opening_year", "d".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(COALESCE("l".total_lent, 0)) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY'), "d".district_id), "year_totals" AS (SELECT opening_year, SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", AVG(amount_lent::NUMERIC / accounts_opened) AS "avg_district_amount_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY opening_year) SELECT opening_year, accounts_opened, total_amount_lent, ROUND(avg_district_amount_per_account, 2) AS "avg_district_amount_per_account" FROM "year_totals" ORDER BY opening_year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date = "l".date ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "end_of_day_account_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH "card_clients" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", "ca".issued, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "dp".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "loan_counts" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "profiled" AS (SELECT "cc".client_id, "cc".gender, "cc".birth_date, "cc".card_type, "cc".age_at_issue, COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("lc".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "cc".gender ORDER BY "cc".age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card_clients" AS "cc" LEFT JOIN "loan_counts" AS "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "cc".account_id) SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, age_rank_within_gender FROM "profiled" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank AS "bank_code", "t".account AS "account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "l".account_id = 930 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) AS "active_loan_accounts" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823) AS "client_accounts" ON "client_accounts".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "female_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "ad".a3 AS "region", "ad".a2 AS "district" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "ac" ON "ac".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "ac".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "selected" AS (SELECT * FROM "female_loans" ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3), "account_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "region_loan_counts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_salaries" AS (SELECT a3 AS "region", AVG(a11) AS "avg_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) SELECT "s".client_id, "s".amount AS "loan_amount", "s".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("s".payments * "s".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("s".payments * "s".duration - "s".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "s".status AS "loan_status", "s".district, "s".region, COALESCE("ast".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "s".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0) > "s".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rlc".loan_count AS "regional_loan_count", ROUND("rs".avg_salary::NUMERIC, 2) AS "regional_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-10-09') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "s".birth_date) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("s".birth_date, 'MMDD') > '1009' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age" FROM "selected" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "account_stats" AS "ast" ON "ast".account_id = "s".account_id INNER JOIN "region_loan_counts" AS "rlc" ON "rlc".region = "s".region INNER JOIN "region_salaries" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "s".region ORDER BY "s".amount DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "district_counts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "q".account_id) AS "qualifying_accounts" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3), "region_totals" AS (SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM(qualifying_accounts) AS "total_accounts" FROM "district_counts" GROUP BY region) SELECT "rt".region, "rt".district_count, "rt".total_accounts, STRING_AGG("dc".district_name, ', ' ORDER BY "dc".district_name ASC) AS "districts" FROM "region_totals" AS "rt" INNER JOIN "district_counts" AS "dc" ON "dc".region = "rt".region GROUP BY "rt".region, "rt".district_count, "rt".total_accounts ORDER BY "rt".region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "monthly_statement_accounts_opened", COUNT(DISTINCT "q".district_id) AS "districts_involved", ROUND(AVG("q".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "q".district_id WHERE "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "disp".account_id FROM "card" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".disp_id = "card".disp_id WHERE "card".type = 'gold') AS "ga" ON "ga".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "trans".account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN "trans".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "trans".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_amount_received", SUM(CASE WHEN "trans".type = 'VYDAJ' THEN "trans".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("trans".bank, "trans".account)) FILTER (WHERE "trans".bank IS NOT NULL AND "trans".account IS NOT NULL AND "trans".account <> 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" GROUP BY "trans".account_id) AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "loan".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" GROUP BY "loan".account_id) AS "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age_years", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "disp" AS "od" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "od".disp_id WHERE "od".account_id = "a".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' AND "ca".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31') AS "card_count", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".date <= DATE '1996-12-31') AS "loan_count", (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'no loan' WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted' WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".date <= DATE '1996-12-31') AS "loan_standing", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01') AS "transaction_count", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "money_in", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER')) AS "money_out", (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("t".balance), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01') AS "peak_balance", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("t".balance), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01') DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "a".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "od".client_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".client_id, "d".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'classic'), "owner_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "classic_card_holding_account_owners" FROM "eligible_accounts" GROUP BY district_id), "external_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ea".district_id, "t".bank, "t".account FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "ea".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0), "external_payment_totals" AS (SELECT "ea".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_outgoing_payment_amount" FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "ea".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "ea".district_id), "external_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "external_accounts_paid" FROM "external_accounts" GROUP BY district_id) SELECT "district".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("owner_counts".classic_card_holding_account_owners, 0) AS "classic_card_holding_account_owners", COALESCE("external_counts".external_accounts_paid, 0) AS "external_accounts_paid", COALESCE("external_payment_totals".total_outgoing_payment_amount, 0) AS "total_outgoing_payment_amount" FROM "district" LEFT JOIN "owner_counts" ON "owner_counts".district_id = "district".district_id LEFT JOIN "external_counts" ON "external_counts".district_id = "district".district_id LEFT JOIN "external_payment_totals" ON "external_payment_totals".district_id = "district".district_id ORDER BY total_outgoing_payment_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01') AS "eligible_branch_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "eligible_branch_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C' LIMIT 501

SELECT cohort, ROUND(AVG(salary)) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort' ELSE 'old cohort' END AS "cohort", "d".a11 AS "salary", CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS "cohort_order" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31') AS "cohort_districts" GROUP BY cohort, cohort_order ORDER BY cohort_order ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((("r853".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC - "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) / "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r853" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r854" ON "r853".driverid = "r854".driverid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r853".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r853".raceid = 853 AND "r854".raceid = 854 AND "r853".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r854".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".positionorder <> 1) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "ra".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

WITH "win_counts" AS (SELECT "r".driverid, COUNT(*) AS "wins" FROM "results" AS "r" WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "r".driverid), "top_driver" AS (SELECT driverid FROM "win_counts" ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points" FROM "top_driver" AS "t" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "t".driverid INNER JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "t".driverid GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(("last_finisher".elapsed_ms - "winner".elapsed_ms) * 100.0 / "last_finisher".elapsed_ms, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM (SELECT "r".milliseconds AS "elapsed_ms" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1988 AND "ra".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "r".position = 1) AS "winner" CROSS JOIN (SELECT "r".milliseconds AS "elapsed_ms" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1988 AND "ra".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "r".position IS NOT NULL AND "r".milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "r".position DESC LIMIT 1) AS "last_finisher" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "dr".laps = "win".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "dr" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "dr".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "dr".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "win" ON "win".raceid = "dr".raceid AND "win".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds::NUMERIC / 1000), 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / COUNT(*) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("r".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "ra".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year = 2008 AND "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full name", MIN("l".milliseconds) AS "shortest lap time (milliseconds)" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "l".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name, (MIN("lt".milliseconds) / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN (MIN("lt".milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ((MIN("lt".milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN MIN("lt".milliseconds) % 1000 < 10 THEN '00' WHEN MIN("lt".milliseconds) % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (MIN("lt".milliseconds) % 1000)::TEXT AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' AND "lt".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name ORDER BY "c".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(pitstop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".stop) AS "pitstop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".raceid NOT IN (SELECT raceid FROM "races" WHERE year = 2000) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_pitstops" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT(*) AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY q3_times DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501
