SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "q".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 1995 AND "ra".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra2" ON "q2".raceid = "ra2".raceid WHERE "ra2".year = 1995 AND "ra2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q1) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MIN(BTRIM("q2".q1)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q1) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q1" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q1".raceid INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q2" ON "q2".raceid = "q1".raceid AND "q2".driverid <> "q1".driverid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d1" ON "d1".driverid = "q1".driverid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2010 AND "d1".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d1".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "q1".position < "q2".position LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "qx" WHERE "qx".raceid = "q".raceid AND "qx".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "qx".q2 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) AS "runners_up" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "r".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) >= 2 ORDER BY runners_up DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, TO_CHAR("r".time::TIME + "res".milliseconds * INTERVAL '1 millisecond', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "finish_clock_time", "d".url FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND ("q".q3 IS NULL OR BTRIM("q".q3) = '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' ORDER BY "q".q2::INTERVAL ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND "q".q2 < '1:40.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(driver_q3_count), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times_per_driver" FROM (SELECT "d".driverid, COUNT("q".q3) FILTER (WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '') AS "driver_q3_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid) AS "cohort" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared" ON "shared".forename = "d".forename WHERE "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "d".code IS NULL AND POSITION(':' IN "q".q1) > 0 AND SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER < 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("res".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "d".driverid AND "lt".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

WITH "editions" AS (SELECT raceid, date FROM "races" WHERE name = 'French Grand Prix' AND year >= 1990), "driver_best" AS (SELECT "e".raceid, "l".driverid, MIN("l".milliseconds) AS "best_ms" FROM "editions" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "e".raceid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".raceid, "l".driverid) SELECT "e".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, ("b".best_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN ("b".best_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (("b".best_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN "b".best_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN "b".best_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ("b".best_ms % 1000)::TEXT AS "fastest_lap" FROM "editions" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "driver_best" AS "b" ON "b".raceid = "e".raceid AND "b".best_ms > 90000 LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "b".driverid ORDER BY "e".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC, "b".best_ms ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY (SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER * 1000 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, '.', 2)::INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "q".q3, "d".forename, "d".surname, "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d".dob) > 1980 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> ''), "timed" AS (SELECT q3, forename, surname, race_name, year, (SPLIT_PART(q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART(q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) AS "seconds" FROM "eligible") SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS "full_name", race_name, year AS "race_year", q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "timed" WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM "timed") LIMIT 501

WITH "driver_race_fastest" AS (SELECT "lt".raceid, "lt".driverid, MIN("lt".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" AS "lt" WHERE "lt".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "lt".raceid, "lt".driverid), "ranked" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY fastest_ms ASC) AS "speed_rank" FROM "driver_race_fastest") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "count" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".speed_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "season_totals" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "season_row" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid), "career" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("st".points) FILTER (WHERE "st".season_row = 1), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "season_totals" AS "st" ON "st".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT career.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "res".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "fastest_lap_constructors" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "r".constructorid FROM "results" AS "r" WHERE "r".rank = 1) SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "fastest_lap_constructors" AS "f" ON "f".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year AS "season", COUNT("p".stop) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 AND "r".raceid IN (SELECT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000 > 120000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p2".milliseconds IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "selected_driver" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "r".name AS "race_name", "r".date AS "race_date" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "selected_driver" AS "sd" ON "sd".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 1), "starts" AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".raceid) AS "races_started" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "selected_driver" AS "sd" ON "sd".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) SELECT "sd".forename || ' ' || "sd".surname AS "full_name", "sd".nationality, "fw".race_name AS "first_race_won", "fw".race_date AS "first_win_date", "starts".races_started FROM "selected_driver" AS "sd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" CROSS JOIN "starts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid AND "res".constructorid = "q".constructorid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "res".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

WITH "q2_times" AS (SELECT "q".driverid, "q".raceid, "q".q2 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> ''), "fastest" AS (SELECT MIN(q2) AS "time" FROM "q2_times") SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "q2_times" AS "q" INNER JOIN "fastest" AS "f" ON "q".q2 = "f".time INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid ORDER BY "d".surname ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "d".number IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN(btrim("q2".q3)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND btrim("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "runner_up".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "runner_up" ON "runner_up".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "st" ON "st".statusid = "runner_up".statusid WHERE "c".name = 'Shanghai International Circuit' AND "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "runner_up".position = 2 ORDER BY "r".time ASC, "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "d".code IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("d".code) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number AS "permanent_career_race_number", "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL < INTERVAL '1 minute 38 seconds' LIMIT 501

WITH "timed_races" AS (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "bounds" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest_time", MAX(start_time) AS "latest_time" FROM "timed_races") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "t".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "t".circuitref ASC) FROM "timed_races" AS "t" CROSS JOIN "bounds" AS "b" WHERE "t".start_time = "b".earliest_time) AS "earliest_circuitref", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "t".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "t".circuitref ASC) FROM "timed_races" AS "t" CROSS JOIN "bounds" AS "b" WHERE "t".start_time = "b".latest_time) AS "latest_circuitref", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("b".latest_time - "b".earliest_time))::BIGINT AS "gap_seconds" FROM "bounds" AS "b" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "res".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("res".fastestlapspeed) <> '' ORDER BY CAST("res".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 2017 AND "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR BTRIM("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "r".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".position IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_expense_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("ex".cost) AS "event_expense_total" FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "ex".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "ex".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "ex".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN -"b".spent ELSE 0 END) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE ("e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01') OR ("e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01') LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending", SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget_amount" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "ratios" AS (SELECT event_id, event_name, total_spending::NUMERIC / NULLIF(total_budget_amount, 0) AS "spending_ratio" FROM "event_totals") SELECT event_name FROM "ratios" WHERE spending_ratio = (SELECT MAX(spending_ratio) FROM "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "name" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "head_count", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".n)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "n" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "x") AS "average_count", CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') > (SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".n)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "n" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "x") THEN 'more' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') < (SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".n)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "n" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "x") THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" LIMIT 501

WITH "college_majors" AS (SELECT major_id, major_name, department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "member_counts" AS (SELECT link_to_major AS "major_id", COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT "cm".department, STRING_AGG("cm".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "cm".major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", COALESCE(STRING_AGG("cm".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "cm".major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE("mc".member_count, 0) > 0), '') AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("mc".member_count), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT("cm".major_id), 2) AS "average_members_per_major_offered" FROM "college_majors" AS "cm" LEFT JOIN "member_counts" AS "mc" ON "mc".major_id = "cm".major_id GROUP BY "cm".department ORDER BY "cm".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event IN (SELECT "e2".event_id FROM "event" AS "e2" WHERE "e2".type = "e".type AND "e2".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e2".event_date < '2020-01-01')) AS "members_attended", COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b" WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT "e3".event_id FROM "event" AS "e3" WHERE "e3".type = "e".type AND "e3".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e3".event_date < '2020-01-01')), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT department, total_dues FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Engineering') AS "d" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "inc".income_id, "inc".amount FROM "major" AS "maj" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "maj".major_id INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "income" AS "inc" ON "inc".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "inc".source = 'Dues' WHERE "maj".college = 'College of Engineering' AND "maj".department = "d".department AND "m".position = 'Member') AS "individual_dues") AS "sums" ON TRUE ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "member"."first_name", "member"."last_name", ROUND(SUM("budget"."amount" - "budget"."spent")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "expense"."link_to_member", "expense"."link_to_budget" FROM "expense" WHERE "expense"."cost" > 50) AS "qualifying_expenses" ON "member"."member_id" = "qualifying_expenses"."link_to_member" INNER JOIN "budget" ON "qualifying_expenses"."link_to_budget" = "budget"."budget_id" GROUP BY "member"."member_id", "member"."first_name", "member"."last_name" ORDER BY "total_amount_left" DESC, "member"."last_name" ASC, "member"."first_name" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("i".amount) AS "total_dues_collected" FROM "income" AS "i" WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "i".link_to_member IN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football%') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "m2".major_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m1" ON "m".link_to_major = "m1".major_id INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".college = "m1".college WHERE "m".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "m".last_name = 'Hewitt' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" INNER JOIN "major" AS "em" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "em".major_id WHERE "em".major_name = "m2".major_name AND "em".college = "m2".college)) AS "majors_without_members" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".major_id = "mb".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX(count_per_major) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) AS "count_per_major" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mb2" ON "mb2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".major_id = "mb2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m2".major_name) AS "counts") ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" WHERE "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_of_majors_without_members" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

WITH "attendance_counts" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') AS "is_officer", COUNT("a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) SELECT CASE WHEN is_officer THEN 'officers' ELSE 'other students' END AS "group_name", ROUND(AVG(event_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM "attendance_counts" GROUP BY is_officer ORDER BY is_officer DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS "count" FROM (SELECT TRIM(lower(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ', '), ', ', 1))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".remaining < 0 AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-08-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(lower(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ', '), ', ', 2))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".remaining < 0 AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-08-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(lower(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ', '), ', ', 3))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".remaining < 0 AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-08-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01') AS "u" WHERE item <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "water_costs" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("ex".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "ex".expense_description IN ('Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, Cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips', 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies') GROUP BY "b".link_to_event), "attendee_counts" AS (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendee_counts" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "water_costs" AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE link_to_major IN (SELECT major_id FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences')) AS "members_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE link_to_major IS NULL OR link_to_major NOT IN (SELECT major_id FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences')) AS "members_not_in_college" FROM "member" LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'), "event_max_lines" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event, MAX("b".amount) AS "max_line_amount" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "chip_events" AS "c" ON "c".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event GROUP BY "b".link_to_event), "top_amount" AS (SELECT MAX(max_line_amount) AS "amount" FROM "event_max_lines") SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event_max_lines" AS "m" INNER JOIN "top_amount" AS "t" ON "m".max_line_amount = "t".amount INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "m".link_to_event LIMIT 501

WITH "vp_expenses" AS (SELECT "e".expense_date, "e".cost FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President'), "latest_date" AS (SELECT MAX(expense_date) AS "expense_date" FROM "vp_expenses") SELECT "ld".expense_date, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "latest_date" AS "ld" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".expense_date = "ld".expense_date GROUP BY "ld".expense_date ORDER BY "ld".expense_date DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

WITH "college_counts" AS (SELECT "mj".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "mj".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "member" AS "mem" INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "mem".link_to_major = "mj".major_id GROUP BY "mj".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS "top_count" FROM "college_counts") SELECT college, major_count FROM "ranked" WHERE major_count = top_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < DATE '2019-10-01' AND "x".expense_description = 'Pizza' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_totals".total_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM(NULLIF("b".spent, 0)), 0) AS "total_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget", SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending", COUNT("ex".expense_id) AS "purchase_count" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "totals" ON "totals".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' AND COALESCE("totals".total_spending, 0) <= COALESCE("totals".total_budget, 0) ORDER BY COALESCE("totals".purchase_count, 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "event_attendance" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "ranked" AS (SELECT type, members_attended, MAX(members_attended) OVER () AS "max_attended" FROM "event_attendance") SELECT type, members_attended FROM "ranked" WHERE members_attended = max_attended LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description AS "item_name", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-11-01' AND "e".approved = 'true' GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b" WHERE "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 30

SELECT "ex".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "ex".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "ex".expense_description ORDER BY "ex".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "member_totals" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "e".expense_description) AS "kind_count", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e".link_to_member WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name) SELECT full_name, kind_count, total_spending FROM "member_totals" WHERE kind_count = (SELECT MAX(kind_count) FROM "member_totals") LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT("s".id), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name HAVING COUNT("s".id) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT("s2".id) AS "cnt" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p2".publisher_name) AS "counts") LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour IS NOT NULL AND "hair".colour IS NOT NULL AND "skin".colour IS NOT NULL AND "eye".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "hair".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "skin".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name) SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(superhero_count) = MIN(superhero_count) THEN 'Tie' ELSE (SELECT publisher_name FROM "counts" ORDER BY superhero_count DESC LIMIT 1) END AS "publisher", MAX(superhero_count) - MIN(superhero_count) AS "difference" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pm" ON "pm".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "pm".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "m" ON "m".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pm2" ON "pm2".id = "m".publisher_id WHERE "pm2".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "hp2".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "d" ON "d".id = "hp2".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pd" ON "pd".id = "d".publisher_id WHERE "pd".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ss_hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "ss_hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "ss_sp" ON "ss_sp".id = "ss_hp".power_id WHERE "ss_sp".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength_heroes" ON "strength_heroes".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".hero_id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ss_hp2".hero_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "ss_hp2" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "ss_sp2" ON "ss_sp2".id = "ss_hp2".power_id WHERE "ss_sp2".power_name = 'Super Strength')) AS "exclusive_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC)::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_hulk".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_hulk" ON "ha_hulk".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_hulk" ON "a_hulk".id = "ha_hulk".attribute_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "a_hulk".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "s".id, "s".height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "s".height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0), "top_heroes" AS (SELECT id FROM "ranked" WHERE height_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "top_heroes" AS "th" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "th".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_pub" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dc_eye".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel_eye".colour FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "marvel_pub" ON "marvel".publisher_id = "marvel_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "marvel_eye" ON "marvel".eye_colour_id = "marvel_eye".id WHERE "marvel_pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye_colours" ON "shared_eye_colours".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dc_pub".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "powered_heroes" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "powered_heroes".hero_id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' LIMIT 501

WITH "documented" AS (SELECT "s".id, "g".gender FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name ~ '[[:space:]]'), "counts" AS (SELECT "d".id, "d".gender, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "documented" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "d".id GROUP BY "d".id, "d".gender) SELECT gender, ROUND(AVG(power_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "counts" GROUP BY gender ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'Male' THEN 1 WHEN 'Female' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name ILIKE '%George Lucas%' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp".power_id = "hp3".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".id <> (SELECT id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man') AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".height_cm = (SELECT MIN("s2".height_cm) FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "s2".race_id = "r2".id WHERE "r2".race = 'Human' AND "s2".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s2".height_cm <> 0) LIMIT 501

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg > 0), "counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "lightest" AS "l" ON "s".weight_kg = "l".weight_kg LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) FROM "counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "superhero".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "superhero".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "superhero_brown".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "superhero_brown" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_brown" ON "superhero_brown".hair_colour_id = "hair_brown".id WHERE "hair_brown".colour = 'Brown' AND "superhero_brown".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL) AND "hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY count DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".weight_kg FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0) AS "distinct_heroes" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "platelet_lab" ON "platelet_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_lab" ON "rnp_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "platelet_lab".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "rnp_lab".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "rnp_lab".rnp::NUMERIC > 5 LIMIT 501
