SELECT id, date, dna::NUMERIC AS "anti_dna_level" FROM "laboratory" WHERE dna IS NOT NULL AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND admission IN ('+', '+(')) AND dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 16 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "id" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "hct" IS NOT NULL AND ("hct" <= 29 OR "hct" >= 52)) AS "h" ON "h"."id" = "p"."id" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "id" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "rnp"::INTEGER > 16) AS "r" ON "r"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA')), "patient_normal_status" AS (SELECT "e".id, COUNT("l".plt) FILTER (WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) AS "normal_results" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_results > 0) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_results = 0) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet_result" FROM "patient_normal_status" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') AND birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rnp::INTEGER > 64) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::BIGINT > 32 GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT symptom FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "e".symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%' THEN 'thrombocytopenia' END AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN "e".symptoms LIKE '%thrombophlebitis%' THEN 'thrombophlebitis' END FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "symptoms_by_episode" WHERE symptom IS NOT NULL GROUP BY symptom ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, symptom ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p".first_visit_date)) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT id, MIN("First Date") AS "first_visit_date" FROM "patient" WHERE admission LIKE '%+%' GROUP BY id) AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".first_visit_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" = '300') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_cre_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT "u"."T-CHO", "u".admission, "u".id FROM (SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "p".id, 1 AS "n" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("x"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "x" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "y" ON "y".id = "x".id WHERE "y".admission = '+' AND "x"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "p".id, 2 AS "n" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("x"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "x" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "y" ON "y".id = "x".id WHERE "y".admission = '-' AND "x"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL)) AS "u" ORDER BY "u".n ASC, "u".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "l".rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".rnp::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') AND "p".admission IN ('-', '') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND ("e".id IS NULL OR ("e".kct <> '+' AND "e".rvvt <> '+' AND "e".lac <> '+')) LIMIT 501

SELECT "patient".id FROM "patient" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "most_recent_lab_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "latest_lab_date" ON "latest_lab_date".id = "patient".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "most_recent_scl70_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "latest_scl70_date" ON "latest_scl70_date".id = "patient".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "latest_scl70" ON "latest_scl70".id = "latest_scl70_date".id AND "latest_scl70".date = "latest_scl70_date".most_recent_scl70_date WHERE "latest_lab_date".most_recent_lab_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "latest_scl70".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id HAVING BOOL_OR(ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND BOOL_OR("U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0', '-15'))) AS "patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".rnp::BIGINT AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".rnp_value = (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligibility_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg IS NOT NULL AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450)) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "LDH measurements within normal range" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id AND "anemia".hgb < 10 WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "patient_max" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex), "global_max" AS (SELECT MAX(max_rnp) AS "max_rnp" FROM "patient_max") SELECT "pm".id, "pm".sex, "pm".max_rnp FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" CROSS JOIN "global_max" AS "gm" WHERE "pm".max_rnp = "gm".max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".got, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date ASC) AS "first_lab" WHERE "first_lab".got < 60 AND "first_lab".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "first_lab".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_tests" AS (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "r".date, "r"."U-PRO" FROM "ranked_tests" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 AND "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id ORDER BY "qualifying".highest_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([,[:space:]]|$)' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "elevated" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 4), "patient_status" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, ("x".id IS NOT NULL) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "elevated" AS "x" ON "x".id = "e".id) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_rnp_result_ge_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient_status" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "li".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "sle_patients" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%'), "measured" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna, "l".dna::NUMERIC AS "dna_value" FROM "sle_patients" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".dna IS NOT NULL), "top_value" AS (SELECT MAX(dna_value) AS "max_dna_value" FROM "measured") SELECT "m".id, "m".diagnosis, "m".dna FROM "measured" AS "m" CROSS JOIN "top_value" AS "t" WHERE "m".dna_value = "t".max_dna_value LIMIT 501

WITH "most_recent" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_rnp" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "most_recent" AS "m" ON "l".id = "m".id AND "l".date = "m".latest_date) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest_rnp" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "r".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l"."rnp", "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER > 64 AND "l".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(')) AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatient_clinic", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~ '(^|[, ]+)SLE([, ]|$)' AND diagnosis !~ 'SLE susp' AND admission IN ('+', '+(', '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "high_ldh" ON "high_ldh".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '1000', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000', '>=100') GROUP BY id) AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission ILIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "l".rbc < 3.5 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%suspect%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".id IN (SELECT "sm".id FROM "laboratory" AS "sm" WHERE "sm".sm IN ('negative', '0')) AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0) AND "p".id IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)')) GROUP BY "p".id) AS "q" LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "r".rbc IS NOT NULL AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "n".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "n".rnp <> 'negative' AND "n".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 'FM999999990.0') AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 15 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F'), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type = '-' LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_without_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a"."molecule_id" IN (SELECT "b"."molecule_id" FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b"."bond_type" = '#') AND "a"."molecule_id" IN (SELECT "a2"."molecule_id" FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2"."element" IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / COUNT(*), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_bond_groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') AS "all_single_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "differences" AS (SELECT all_single_bonds, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_noncarcinogenic" FROM "molecule_bond_groups" GROUP BY all_single_bonds) SELECT CASE WHEN all_single_bonds THEN 'every bond is single' ELSE 'not every bond is single' END AS "bond_group", carcinogenic_minus_noncarcinogenic FROM "differences" ORDER BY all_single_bonds DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_atom" ON "other_atom".element = "a".element AND "other_atom".molecule_id <> "a".molecule_id WHERE "other_atom".atom_id IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element = 'n' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id HAVING NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "n" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "n".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "n".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "n".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "eligible" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

WITH "triple_bond_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#'), "labeled" AS (SELECT "m".label FROM "triple_bond_molecules" AS "t" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "t".molecule_id WHERE "m".label IN ('+', '-')), "totals" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') AS "carcinogenic_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "non_carcinogenic_count" FROM "labeled") SELECT ROUND(100.0 * carcinogenic_count / total_count, 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * non_carcinogenic_count / total_count, 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "rare_atom" ON "rare_atom".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "rare_atom".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "rare_atom".atom_id) INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "rare_atom".element IN (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id), "carbon_touching" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "carbon_touching" AS "ct" ON "ct".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT rank, molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "yt" AS (SELECT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element = 'y') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "yt" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON ("h".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id2) AND "h".element = 'h' AND "h".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_degree), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_degree" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degrees" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(*) AS "count_of_bonds" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".atom_id NOT IN (SELECT "c2".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id WHERE "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
